head.text: WF-013 CK and DQ phase for ck_phase = 0 and 1 (CK = CLK-CORE / 2)

signal: Launch (one slot = half a CLK-CORE period)

foot.text: ck_phase = 0: CK toggles on the falling edge of i_clk_core, so each CK edge lies in the middle of a data interval (1.25 ns from the DQ change at 200 MHz CK). ck_phase = 1: CK and DQ change on the same rising edge.
